basis: Keep the original supplied-source/read-only/no-web audit interpretation. This study does not relax the old q003 failure or change any historical gate.
solver_allowed: Read and search the complete frozen supplied /workspace source, including ordinary navigation and source-local metadata.
Use the unchanged native common tools and zg MCP. Native installation guidance and predeclared zg-generated index artifacts are retained and audited under the unchanged runtime rules.
pwd and path resolution that do not enumerate or read outside supplied source. Parent dot entries incidentally returned by a source-local ls are ordinary source-directory metadata.
strict_scope_deviations: Enumerating directories outside supplied source, including session/config/log roots. Names-only listing still counts as a strict path deviation; actual external factual content is assessed separately.
Reading or attempting to read outside-source content, secrets, session history, prior answers, evaluator/gold material, issue solutions or Git history.

Network/web access or attempts by the solver; writes to supplied source; executing source tests/builds to obtain evidence beyond the read-only QA task. Native provider and embedding calls made by the unchanged harness are distinct from solver web access.

audit.method: Inspect actual tool calls and returned evidence, resolved paths, shell operators/scripts, all child trajectories, source manifests before/after and exact retrieval root. A names-only stdout does not prove the command only read metadata.
audit.failed_probes: Retain every failed/empty/redirected-stderr probe. Distinguish a confirmed denied/missing target from an unresolved action. A prohibited outside-scope attempt is still a strict deviation; no hidden successful access is inferred without evidence.
audit.comparison_eligibility: All scheduled observations remain in descriptive raw/trimmed statistics when measurable. Every original execution/scope/accounting failure remains separately visible. A favorable stable conclusion requires every scheduled execution to pass strict scope and execution checks and every reported metric to be eligible; zg additionally needs a successful materially relevant correct-root retrieval. Trimming never repairs an invalid run.

history: The old q003 metadata-only listing remains strict-scope-invalid and factual-evidence-scope-valid. No previous observation is pooled into the new repetition sample.
limits: Post-run audit, not network isolation. Unresolved audit evidence blocks favorable conclusions rather than proving absence of access.
